sql:
select 'parity' src, case when series like 'KXBTCD%' then 'KXBTCD' when series ~ '^(KXATP|KXWTA|KXITF)' then 'tennis' else 'other' end grp, coalesce(live_outcome,'-') live_outcome, coalesce(twin_outcome,'-') twin_outcome, count(*) n
 from live_paper_parity_events where live_tag='Jmmsell10' and recorded_at >= '2026-10-10T12:40:00Z' and (series like 'KXBTCD%' or series ~ '^(KXATP|KXWTA|KXITF)') group by 1,2,3,4
union all
select 'live_orders', case when market_ticker like 'KXBTCD%' then 'KXBTCD' when market_ticker ~ '^(KXATP|KXWTA|KXITF)' then 'tennis' else 'other' end, status, '-', count(*)
 from live_orders where strategy='Jmmsell10' and action='buy' and created_at >= '2026-10-10T12:40:00Z' group by 1,2,3
order by 1,2,3
